body.heading: Where in the world is Monaco?
paragraphs: Monaco is a country in Western Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Monaco is Monaco. Monaco is a country and a city in one — a tiny city-state on the French Riviera, smaller than New York's Central Park.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Monaco is French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Monaco is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Monaco?
paragraphs: Monaco covers about 2 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Monaco packs glamour into two square kilometres: the Prince's Palace with its changing of the guard, the casino square and supercars along the harbour.
Cliffside above the sea, Monaco's Oceanographic Museum has aquariums of sharks and turtles and was directed for years by explorer Jacques Cousteau.

body.heading: Think and talk

2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
